text:
maria: Hi all — PR #3421 (optimize-batching) is ready for re-review. I addressed the comments from @alex and @jordan, added a regression test, and updated the changelog. PTAL when you have a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/3421

alex: thanks — quick skim: CI had a flake on the windows container earlier, is that expected?

maria: good catch, I reproduced it locally. pushed a fix (changed the temp-dir cleanup ordering) and re-triggered CI. added a note in the PR about the flake.

jordan: LGTM for the runtime changes. left one small nit about using debug vs info for one log line (helps noisy logs). can you swap that and squash? then i'll approve.

maria: done, switched to debug and squashed into the last commit. also rebased onto main to pick up the latest upstream CI config. ping me if you want a different commit message.

jordan: nice, thanks. i'll approve but hold off on merge until the morning merge window (10:00-11:00 PT) so we can coordinate the deploy. is that okay?

maria: yes, that works for me. thanks! :tada:

deploy-bot: CI build passed (unit/integration/e2e) — all checks green.

sam: quick ask — can you add a one-line blurb for the release notes? we'll mention the batching perf tweak and the new flag.

maria: added a short release note snippet in the PR description under "release-notes: ready".

jordan: Approved. i'll rebase to main and merge at ~10:05 PT tomorrow during the merge window. @alex if you want a last look, ping me before 10:00.

alex: i'll trust your review and the CI run. :+1:

deploy-bot: Merged pull request #3421 into main by jordan at 1754216920.
